description: This file defines a Flutter screen widget for displaying a media gallery, including filtering options for photos and videos, rendering of media items, and layout management.

classes.name: GalleryScreen
classes.description: Main widget for displaying the media gallery, with filtering and grid layout.

classes.name: _GalleryScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the filtering, layout, and rendering of gallery items.

classes.name: _MediaCard
classes.description: Widget representing individual media items within the gallery grid.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the GalleryScreen, including app bar, filters, grid of media, and empty state message.

methods.name: _MediaCard.build
methods.description: Builds the individual media item card, displaying image, overlay icon for videos, duration label, title, and subtitle.
